{{Top|leg}}
'''RepMed vita paste''' was an edible paste provided for those beings unable to consume food normally. After his injuries on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] consumed this product through feeding straws in his mask. [[DD-13 medical assistant droid/Legends|DD-13]] made the implication that it tasted awful.<ref>{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2011/09/5-things-you-didnt-know-about-darth.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=5 Things You Didn't Know About Darth Vader}}</ref>
